stories.title: 居民房贷贴息政策10月1日起实施

en.title: Residential mortgage interest subsidy policy to be implemented from October 1
en.summary: A residential mortgage interest subsidy policy will begin implementation on October 1. The policy aims to provide financial support to homeowners through interest subsidies on residential mortgages.

stories.title: 陈芋汐用“坚韧”形容自己这五年

en.title: Chen Yusi Describes Herself as "Resilient" Over These Five Years
en.summary: Chinese diver Chen Yusi won gold in the women's 10-meter platform final at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games with a score of 432.65 points, earning her second gold medal of the competition.

stories.title: China mourns death of music legend Liu Huan, voice of 2008 Beijing Olympic theme song

en.title: China mourns death of music legend Liu Huan, voice of 2008 Beijing Olympic theme song
en.summary: Liu Huan, a renowned Chinese singer and songwriter who performed the 2008 Beijing Olympic theme song, died in Shanghai on September 25 at age 63 from illness. He was a respected music figure who taught at a Beijing university for three decades.

stories.title: Can China’s new satellite coordination standards boost PLA targeting and resilience?

en.title: Can China's new satellite coordination standards boost PLA targeting and resilience?
en.summary: Chinese researchers are developing voluntary standards for autonomous satellite coordination and data sharing. An expert panel approved work on 10 proposed standards, with draft texts to be released for consultation.

stories.title: 李雯雯亚运会举重夺冠：“我就是奔着金牌来的！”

en.title: Li Wenwen wins Asian Games weightlifting title: "I came for the gold medal!"
en.summary: Chinese weightlifter Li Wenwen won the women's over-86 kilogram category at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games with a total of 310 kilograms.

stories.title: 中国人民银行调整完善若干货币政策工具

en.title: People's Bank of China adjusts and improves certain monetary policy tools
en.summary: China's central bank is adjusting and refining several monetary policy tools to implement moderately loose monetary policy and create conditions for stable economic growth and financial market stability.

stories.title: 从“增人数”到“增效益” 湖南岳阳以“真金白银”激活文旅体商融合消费

en.title: From "increasing numbers" to "increasing benefits": Yueyang, Hunan activates cultural-tourism-sports-commerce integrated consumption with real financial incentives
en.summary: Yueyang city unveiled policy measures combining cultural, tourism, sports, and commercial sectors to boost consumer spending and shift local industries from event-driven effects toward sustained prosperity.

stories.title: “第二届南岛语族与海洋文明”国际学术研讨会在华侨大学举办

en.title: Second International Academic Symposium on Austronesian Languages and Maritime Civilization held at Huaqiao University
en.summary: An international academic symposium on Austronesian languages and maritime civilization took place at Huaqiao University's Xiamen campus on September 29, aimed at exploring historical connections and advancing scholarly research and dialogue in the field.

stories.title: Chinese deep-ocean drilling ship brings home ‘precious’ South China Sea samples

en.title: Chinese deep-ocean drilling ship brings home 'precious' South China Sea samples
en.summary: China's Mengxiang deep-ocean drilling ship completed its first South China Sea expedition, setting a national depth record and collecting basalt core samples to study the region's geological history.

stories.title: China's deep-sea drilling capacity reaches 5,000-meter level

en.title: China's deep-sea drilling capacity reaches 5,000-meter level
en.summary: China's Mengxiang ocean drilling vessel has set a national record by achieving 5,000-meter deep-sea drilling capability after collecting basalt samples from the South China Sea.

stories.title: Eunis Chan, Angela Leong sell luxury Hong Kong properties as rate increases loom

en.title: Eunis Chan, Angela Leong sell luxury Hong Kong properties as rate increases loom
en.summary: Model-actress Eunis Chan and billionaire Angela Leong have sold luxury Hong Kong properties amid expectations of rising interest rates. Chan sold a Mid-Levels flat for HK$32.25 million at approximately 130 percent profit.

stories.title: China’s CXMT to favour domestic suppliers in US$5.2b memory-chip capacity push: source

en.title: China's CXMT to favour domestic suppliers in US$5.2b memory-chip capacity push: source
en.summary: Chinese memory chip manufacturer CXMT plans to invest 34.9 billion yuan in expansion, allocating funds across technology research and development and wafer testing facilities while prioritizing domestic suppliers of chipmaking equipment.

stories.title: Why Citi is betting on China’s 30-year bonds as US Treasury yields climb

en.title: Why Citi is betting on China's 30-year bonds as US Treasury yields climb
en.summary: Citibank analysts have become optimistic about Chinese 30-year government bonds, expecting their yields to decline to around 1.8 percent despite rising US Treasury yields. The bank recommends investors increase their positions in China's long-term sovereign debt based on easing supply pressures and improving market conditions.

stories.title: AstraZeneca, Merck, Novo deals boost Chinese biotech as global interest grows

en.title: AstraZeneca, Merck, Novo deals boost Chinese biotech as global interest grows
en.summary: AstraZeneca invested $2 billion in Summit Therapeutics to develop and commercialize a Chinese biotech company's cancer drug globally, while Merck announced a separate deal. These transactions demonstrate renewed international confidence in China's biotech sector amid reduced concerns about US restrictions.

stories.title: ‘180-degree flip’ sees global investors turn to China for diversification: Pimco president

en.title: '180-degree flip' sees global investors turn to China for diversification: Pimco president
en.summary: Pimco, managing over $2 trillion in assets, reports that international investors are increasingly seeking Chinese bonds to diversify away from crowded US markets. The shift reflects a dramatic reversal in investor sentiment toward China's economy and financial assets.
